name: Dangerous Cat 78
author: ercnersoy
description: Rounded white text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks:
On focus, outline-color becomes #e8e8e8, background changes from #e8e8e8 to #e8e8e8, box-shadow becomes inset 20px 20px 60px #c5c5c5,
		inset -20px -20px 60px #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dangerous Cat 78</title>
<style>
/* Dangerous Cat 78 by ercnersoy — https://uiverse.io/ercnersoy/dangerous-cat-78 */
.input {
 border: none;
 padding: 1rem;
 border-radius: 1rem;
 background: #e8e8e8;
 box-shadow: 20px 20px 60px #c5c5c5,
		-20px -20px 60px #ffffff;
 transition: 0.3s;
}

.input:focus {
 outline-color: #e8e8e8;
 background: #e8e8e8;
 box-shadow: inset 20px 20px 60px #c5c5c5,
		inset -20px -20px 60px #ffffff;
 transition: 0.3s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Type here...">

</body>
</html>
